title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Corridor 3 (Bishkek-Osh Road) Improvement Project, Phase 4

description.narrative: The project will improve national and regional connectivity by reconstructing and rehabilitating an estimated 120 km of crucial road sections between Bishkek and Osh, and will include road safety measures such as road signs, lane markings, street lighting, parking areas, bus stops, crash barriers, and sidewalks. The impact of the project will be enhanced regional connectivity and trade via CAREC Corridor 3. The outcome will be improved efficiency and safer movement of goods and people on the Bishkek-Osh road. The project outputs will be (i) 52.5 km of rehabilitated road from Bishkek to Kara Balta, (ii) 67 km of rehabilitated road from Madaniyat to Jalalabad, (iii) strengthened road asset management system, and (iv) improved road safety.

Loan 3056: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 12 Oct 2024

Progress Toward Outcome: L3056-KGZ was financially closed on 22 August 2023 while G0366-KGZ is expected to be financially closed by 30 September 2024. A project completion report will be prepared within 12 months after the financial closing date of the project.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45169/45169-001-apfs-en_7.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Nov 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45169/45169-001-iee-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Sep 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45169/45169-001-rp-en.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | May 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45169/45169-001-sddr-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45169/45169-001-smr-en_18.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: (i) Road from Bishkek to Kara-Balta reconstructed--
(a) 45.1 km road section was reconstructed and handed over to MOTC on 29 November 2021. As of 22 July 2024, the progress is 100% complete.
(b) 7.4 km section: As of 22 July 2024, the progress is 100% complete. The Contractor has completed repairing the defects found by the Working Commission. State handover of project road is under preparation.
(ii) Institutional capacity strengthened--
(a) The performance-based maintenance contract was completed on 31 December 2020. Currently, the section is under the routine maintenance by DEU9 (under Road Maintenance Department).
(b) The road safety campaign was implemented from 30 March 2022 to 31 October 2022 during the six-month period prior to the opening of whole 52.5 km section.
(c) The road safety audit for the whole 52.5 km section was conducted.
(d) The study on the structural assessment was completed in November 2019.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/45169-001/main#project-tenders
